description: MCP server manifest for the Nairobi DevOps Community website

servers.name: jetro
servers.description: Jetro AI research platform runtime — provides canvas rendering, data querying, document parsing, and template access
tools: jet_render — create canvas elements (charts, tables, frames, notes, KPI cards)
jet_canvas — manage canvas layout (move, resize, arrange, delete)
jet_parse — convert documents to markdown (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, EML, images with OCR)
servers.security: stdio process — inherits host permissions; no network exposure

recommended_servers.name: filesystem
recommended_servers.description: Secure file access with path allow-lists — useful for AI tools that need read/write access to specific directories
